labels.note: Unanchored strict regex matches protocols mid-string, e.g. '/redirect?u=http://x' returns true in strict mode.
\S drops whitespace support and admits slashes; leading-whitespace URLs fail and '/a:/b' matches.
Unanchored test; one slash is enough to match and the group is never used, so results are identical.
With acceptRelative, paths containing '//' mid-string, like '/a//b', wrongly count as protocol-relative.
Unanchored: 'xjavascript:' or 'myblob:' wrongly flagged as script protocol; a false positive only.
Without $, full strings like 'javascript:alert(1)' now return true; conservative behavior change.
Leading whitespace/tabs before 'javascript:' no longer detected: security check bypass.
Any slash counts as trailing; withTrailingSlash('/path?q', true) returns input unchanged. Common path.
